name: Yamaha Niken
engine: 847 cc liquid-cooled triple, fuel injected, two leaning front wheels
intro: Yamaha's three-wheeler that leans. The MT-09 triple up top, with a double front end that has many bearings to check.

L: The leaning front end has its own bearings and bushings. Check the linkage for play before you trust the steering.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
